name: HBC 494

images.credit: Nogueira et al. 2023, Fig. 2 (Combined panel, crop)

paper.title: Resolving the Binary Components of the Outbursting Protostar HBC 494 with ALMA

notes: FUor-type outbursting protostar embedded in the Orion Molecular Cloud (L1641); the held ALMA Band 6 1.3 mm continuum image (combined high- and low-resolution data) resolves the system into its binary components (Nogueira et al. 2023).
